label: Decision memo
description: A short memo that compares options and recommends one, with sources.
task: Set up a decision memo in this empty folder. Write memo.md with these sections: the decision to make and its deadline, the context, the options (at least three, including doing nothing), the criteria and how each option scores against them in a table, the risks of each, the recommendation and why, and the open questions. Cite every factual claim with a link in a Sources section at the end. Keep it to about two pages. Add a README.md that says what the memo is about and how to update it.
